events.title: Attack UKMTO #204 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 204-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 11 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1800UTC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 14NM northwest of Ra’s al Khaymah, UAE. A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been evacuated safely. Fire-fighting efforts are currently ongoing. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #202 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 202-26. UPDATE 001 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. UPDATE 001: UKMTO have now gained confirmation that the tanker was struck with an unknown projectile whilst transiting the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are reported safe and well. Due to this confirmation, this has been re-classified as an Attack. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #201 10 November 2026 UKMTO INCIDENT 201-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 19NM northeast of Lima, Oman. The Master of a Tanker reports being struck by an unknown projectile. The crew are safe and there is no environmental impact reported. Master will conduct damage assessment at first light. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #203 10 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 203-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 10 Nov 2026 Incident Time: TBC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident in the Arabian Gulf. A tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile whilst travelling eastbound. Multiple casualties were sustained and have been taken ashore for medical assistance. All remaining crew are safe and accounted for. No damage assessment or environmental impact are available at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #200 8 November 2026 UKMTO ADVISORY 200-26. UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. The Company Security Officer of a tanker has reported that the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are safe and accounted for and there is no reported environmental impact at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #199 8 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 199-26. UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 8NM northwest of Khasab, Oman. Military authorities reported the Tanker is on fire which has resulted in the evacuation of the crew. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate. UPDATE 001 UKMTO has reclassified this incident to ATTACK. Attack UKMTO #197 6 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 197-26. UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 16NM east of Khasab, Oman. The Master of a Tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz outbound, has reported an explosion at the waterline, port side. The crew are safe and are accounted for. The tanker is still under its own power and is continuing on its voyage. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.
